text.default: Spend your stars to get new abilities and to improve already gained. Click "Reset" button to reset all your stars and reassign in a different way.
Plague zombie. Unlike other zombies, this one has moderate HP and magic resist. Strikes with his own hands, and can not inflict great damage, but plague weakens your soldiers, lowering attack speed.
